## Context / Problem

Code-review overlay prompts are guarded by standing eval specs (pattern: `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml` — seeded recall + no-fire diff families, deterministic scorers, validated offline with `rebar prompt eval <prompt-id>`). The concurrency overlay's rubric was designed against a corpus of real races traced to their introducing commits; without a standing eval, prompt edits can silently regress exactly the recall/precision behavior that corpus established.

## Approach

Author `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-concurrency.eval.yaml` mirroring the tests-overlay spec shape (`epochs: 3`, `gate: at_least(2)`, deterministic scorers `code_review_emits_valid_findings` / `code_review_recall` / `code_review_no_fire`). Dataset entries are MINIMAL DIFF HUNKS distilled from the traced corpus (each with a provenance comment naming the source commit), not full historical replays.

Grounding in the eval harness (`rebar.llm.evals.eval.run_eval`), NOT assumed: a gating deterministic scorer passes an EPOCH iff every APPLICABLE case passes it (all-or-nothing per epoch); an epoch passes iff `coverage_ok` AND every gating scorer passes; `coverage_threshold` is the fraction of cases that RAN without erroring (a run-success floor, not a pass-rate lever); the ONLY per-run tolerance is `gate: at_least(2)` over `epochs: 3` (a whole-epoch nondeterminism budget). Consequently a persistently-failing gating recall case fails the gate regardless of `coverage_threshold`.

Scored gating dataset:

- RECALL R1 — unlocked twin (`expect: finding`): a `subprocess.run(["git", ..., "commit"])` write to the shared tracker bypassing the locked `event_append` seam sibling writers use (distilled from 9ad46965bd, `eclectic-spotted-barb`).
- RECALL R2 — check-then-act TOCTOU (`expect: finding`): `os.path.getmtime(lock)` -> judge stale -> `os.remove(lock)` with no identity re-validation (distilled from 56e130ff71, `fine-wisteria-solenodon`).
- NO-FIRE F1 (`expect: pass`) — a write lock ADDED around a previously unlocked merge (distilled from 7853af7698).
- NO-FIRE F2 (`expect: pass`) — an atomic-write seam conversion of process-local scratch state (distilled from 95f97cbeb6).
- NO-FIRE F3 (`expect: pass`) — the hard FP control: a DELIBERATE probe-then-skip where the skipped work is explicitly optional and the subsequent operation still takes the real lock (distilled from abbc65adf4).

Known-hard stretch, deliberately NON-GATING:

- RECALL R3 — fail-open guard (distilled from 3938c7ed2d, `greisen-draconian-annelid`): drift between two reads is detected, a warning is emitted, and the operation proceeds anyway on the stale read. This is the hardest case for a less-capable reviewer (the warning reads as "handled"). Because the harness has no per-case exemption for a scored case, R3 is included as a NON-GATING documented stretch — a commented hunk block in the dataset section (provenance + rationale), NOT a scored `- id:` case — so it is tracked but, being unscored, cannot fail the gate by construction. Promoting it to a scored recall case is a future step once the prompt reliably fires on it.

Positive rationale: seeding from traced production bugs makes the eval a regression oracle for the defect classes that actually occurred here (and their nearest benign neighbors), rather than synthetic strawmen; the distilled-hunk form matches the existing eval-spec format exactly.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-concurrency.eval.yaml` (new file).

## Testing

The spec IS the test (LLM behavioral eval per the shared test-design standard section 10): pinned model in the spec, 3 epochs, deterministic scorers, a predeclared gate. In-session oracle: `rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency` (validate-only in this codebase — it checks the spec is well-formed and the scorers/gate resolve) exits 0; the LIVE behavioral run happens in eval CI, exactly as for every sibling overlay spec. The no-fire family is the negative control by construction. The spec is also held to the strict packaged-spec discipline gate (`validate_dataset_and_gold`: unique ids, `expect` in the known vocabulary, a balanced fire/pass dataset, a non-empty gold_set).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-concurrency.eval.yaml` exists and `rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency` exits 0; checked by the command's exit code.
- [x] The spec has at least 2 scored recall cases (`expect: finding`), each with a provenance comment naming its source commit; checked by reading the file.
- [x] The spec has at least 3 scored no-fire cases (`expect: pass`), each with a provenance comment naming its source commit; checked by reading the file.
- [x] The hard FP control F3 (deliberate probe-then-skip that still takes the real lock) is a scored `expect: pass` case; checked by reading the file.
- [x] R3 (fail-open guard) is present as a NON-GATING documented stretch — a commented hunk block carrying its provenance and known-hard rationale, and NOT a scored `- id:` case — so it cannot fail the gate; checked by reading the file.
- [x] A header comment states that `coverage_threshold` is a run-success floor and that the only per-run tolerance is `gate: at_least(2)` over `epochs: 3`; checked by reading the file.
